name: nightscout
title: Nightscout
summary: Glucose from your own Nightscout site, as a live CGM feed (sensor readings every few minutes).

settings.help: For example https://nightscout.example.invalid/. Plain http only for a site on your own network (a single-label host or a private address).

settings.prompt: How often to read new entries, in seconds
settings.help: 60 to 86400. A failed read waits longer each time, up to an hour.

secrets.prompt: A Nightscout access token with the readable role (or the site's API secret)
secrets.help: Create one in Nightscout's Admin tools: a subject with the readable role. Leave empty if your site is readable without one.
